Text-led marketing posts, on square and portrait pictures only (9:16 up to a little wider than square): on wide pictures it picked thumbnails and web pages. CLIP can’t read the words, so what a post is about (sale, giveaway, quote) can’t be a tag.

Boxes, cans and bottles. “A product packaging design” and “a bottle label design” pulled in paper-like social posts, so they were replaced.

Landing pages and website screenshots. Its misses are slides, carousel posts and editorial layouts with a header line.
